A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Can businesses use the existing courier services?+

Yes, the original 3A Logistics service information includes commercial as well as personal shipments. Item and destination acceptance still need to be confirmed.

How can we discuss regular shipments?+

Share your goods, typical parcel sizes, destinations and expected frequency by phone, WhatsApp or through a quote enquiry. The team can discuss the available service arrangements.

Are volume discounts or credit terms available?+

No confirmed discount schedule or credit terms have been supplied. Share your requirement and ask the team for a specific proposal.
